KNOW #5 📚 Stop Loss Kyun Zaroori
Ek trade poora account uda sakti hai. Kaise bachen?
• Stop loss matlab pehle se tay karo, kahan galat ho.
• Bina stop loss chhota loss bada banta hai, phir hope pe trade chalti hai.
• Stop structure ke peeche rakho, random number pe nahi.
Tip: stop loss lagao aur phir use door mat khiskao.
Aur seekhna hai to follow karo. Trade setups ke liye Telegram join karo — link bio me 🕷️
